author: Richie Mills
title: Riverside shuts out Glenbrook thanks to 13-strikeout effort from Jayce Ruiz - NewsBreak
text:
By Richie Mills ,
2 hours ago RESERVE, La. — No. 6 Riverside defeated No. 11 Glenbrook, 5-0, on Wednesday in the second round of the Division IV Select baseball playoffs.
Jayce Ruiz was once again outstanding in the Rebels’ win.
The senior struck out the first 9 batters he faced. He finished with 13 in a complete-game shutout and allowed 1 hit in his 2026 playoff debut.
“After the first nine strikeouts, I kept commanding my fastball. My slider was working, and they couldn’t touch the fastball away, and it was working for me,” Jayce Ruiz said.
Ruiz’s run support came in the form of RBIs from Colten Diamond and Cameron Matt in the bottom of the second inning.
Ruiz added an RBI in the bottom of the sixth.
Riverside junior Brody Vicknair recorded a two-RBI double later in the sixth frame to give the Rebels a five-run advantage heading into the top of the seventh.
Riverside advances to the Division IV Select quarterfinal round, where they will face No. 3, Cedar Creek.
